articles.heading: Icyo aya mabwiriza agamije Aya mabwiriza ashyiraho ibisabwa mu gutanga uruhushya n’andi mabwiriza agenga
articles.text:
abatanga serivisi z’imari batakira amafaranga
abitswa.

articles.heading: Isobanura Muri aya mabwiriza– (a) “ahakorerwa ubucuruzi” bivuga ishami, agashami cyangwa ahandi
articles.text:
hantu hose utanga serivisi z’imari
utakira amafaranga abitswa akorera
bimwe cyangwa byose mu bikorwa
bye;
(b) “Banki Nkuru” bivuga Banki Nkuru
y’u Rwanda;
(c) “iguriza ry’amafaranga” bivuga
igikorwa cyo kuguriza abantu
amafaranga atangirwa inyungu;
(d) “ihanagurabusembwa” bivuga
gusubizwa uburenganzira bwo gukora
mu bigo by’imari bitakira amafaranga
abitswa nyuma yo kwirukanwa
cyangwa guhanishwa ikindi gihano na
Banki Nkuru cyangwa ikindi kigo
kubera imyitwarire idahwitse mu
rwego rw’imari;
(e) “ikigo gifite ubuzima gatozi” bivuga
isosiyete y’ubucuruzi, ubufatanye mu
bucuruzi, koperative, umuryango
cyangwa urundi rwego rwose rufite
uburenganzira n’inshingano
hakurikijwe amategeko;
(f) “ikigo gitanga inguzanyo ku
mishinga y’iterambere” bivuga
utanga serivisi z’imari utanga
inguzanyo yibanda cyane ku mishinga
igamije iterambere ry’ubukungu;
(g) “ikodeshagurisha” bivuga ubwoko
bw’inguzanyo aho umuntu ahabwa
inguzanyo itari amafaranga na nyiri
umutungo utari amafaranga,
uburenganzira bwo gutunga no
gukoresha uwo mutungo mu gihe
runaka bumvikanyeho, maze uwuhawe
akagenda yishyura muri icyo gihe
ubukode bw’ikodeshagurisha
bwumvikanyweho kandi akaba
ashobora kuwegukana igihe ayo
masezerano y’ikodeshagurisha
arangiye;
(h) “igurizanya hagati y’abantu
n’abandi” bivuga uburyo bwo
gukusanya amafaranga y’abantu
benshi hifashishijwe imbuga
koranabuhanga ayo mafaranga
agatangwa nk’inguzanyo zidafite
ingwate kandi abazihawe bakazishyura
bongeyeho inyungu;
(i) “inguzanyo y’iguramutungo
rishingiye ku bwishyu bukorwa mu
byiciro” bivuga inguzanyo ifasha
uyihawe kwegurirwa umutungo aguze,
akagenda yishyura mu byiciro mu gihe
runaka;
(j) “inguzanyo itangirwa ingwate
y’umutungo wimukanwa” bivuga
igikorwa cyo kuguriza amafaranga
hatanzwe ingwate y’ibicuruzwa kandi
ugurije agashyira ibyo bicuruzwa mu
maboko ye ariko ntabigire ibye mu gihe
ategereje kwishyurwa hiyongereyeho
inyungu cyangwa igihembo;
(k)“inguzanyo itishyurwa neza cyangwa
amasezerano atubahirizwa” bivuga
inguzanyo cyangwa amasezerano bisaba
ubwishyu mu byiciro ariko hakaba hari
icyiciro cy’ubwishyu kitishyuwe, cyaba
cyose cyangwa igice cyacyo mu gihe
cy’iminsi 90 uhereye ku munsi ukurikira
itariki yo kwishyuriraho;
(l) “ingwate yo kwishingira kurangiza
akazi” bivuga icyemezo gitangwa n’ikigo
cy’imari cyemewe hagamijwe kwizeza
urwego rutanga isoko ko imirimo ijyanye
n’isoko ritanzwe iramutse itagenze neza,
haba mu rwego rwa tekiniki cyangwa ku
byerekeye kubahiriza ibihe ntarengwa
byagenwe, urwego rutanga isoko,
ruhabwa amafaranga ateganyijwe muri
icyo cyemezo;
(m) “itakazagaciro” bivuga ikinyuranyo
kiri hagati y’agaciro k’isoko ku mutungo
watanzweho ingwate y’inguzanyo
n’amafaranga inguzanyo. Ingano
y’itakazagaciro yerekana ingaruka
zishobora kuba ku watanze inguzanyo
zituruka ku ngwate bitewe n’uko isoko
rihagaze;
(n)“serivisi yo guha umuntu umwenda
ategereje ubwishyu ahandi” bivuga
amasezerano atuma umuhuza mu rwego
rw’imari abasha kugura imyenda ku bigo
by’imari. Ugura imyenda cyangwa uha
undi ubwishyu ategereje ahandi ashobora
no guha ikigo cyangwa umuntu ku giti cye
inguzanyo hashingiwe ku gaciro
k’impamyabuguzi, havanywemo
amafaranga runaka afatwa nka komisiyo
n’igihembo byishyurwa kuri iyo serivisi;
(o) “serivisi zo kongerera ubushobozi
ibigo bitanga serivisi z’imari”
bivuga ubucuruzi bugamije kubonera
umuti ikibazo cy’ibura ry’amafaranga
mu batanga serivisi z’imari,
bagahabwa inguzanyo hagamijwe
kubafasha kongera inguzanyo batanga
cyangwa ubushobozi mu bikorwa
by’ubucuruzi bwabo;
(p) “serivisi zo kwishyuza imyenda”
bivuga igikorwa cyo kwakira ubwishyu
bw’inguzanyo no gukurikirana
ubwishyu bw’imyenda mu izina
ry’utanga serivisi z’imari;
(q) “serivisi z’imari” bivuga serivisi
z’inguzanyo yo kugura umutungo
utimukanwa, ubwishingire
bw’inguzanyo, serivisi zo kongerera
ubushobozi ibigo bitanga serivisi
z’imari, serivisi z’igurizanya hagati
y’abantu n’abandi, serivisi zo kuguriza
amafaranga, serivisi zo guha umuntu
umwenda ategereje ubwishyu ahandi,
serivisi z’ikodeshagurisha, inguzanyo
itangirwa ingwate y’umutungo
wimukanwa, ndetse n’indi serivisi
Banki Nkuru ishobora gufata nka
serivisi y’imari;
(r) “serivisi z’inguzanyo yo kugura
umutungo utimukanwa” bivuga
gutanga inguzanyo yo kugura inyubako
yo guturamo cyangwa y’ubucuruzi
ishingiye ahanini ku ngwate
y’umutungo utimukanwa igizwe
n’uwo mutungo waguzwe
hakoreshejwe iyo nguzanyo;
(s) “ubwishingire bw’inguzanyo”
bivuga ingwate yo kwishingira uhabwa
inguzanyo igakoreshwa mu kwishyura
inguzanyo yose cyangwa igice cyayo
igihe haba ingorane z’uko uwahawe
inguzanyo atayishyuye. Iyo inguzanyo
itishyuwe, uwatanze inguzanyo asaba
uwishingiye inguzanyo kumuha
agaciro kangana n’ubwishingire
yiyemeje;
(t) “umuhuza muri serivisi
z’inguzanyo” bivuga ikigo kidafite
aho gihuriye n’utanga cyangwa
uhabwa inguzanyo gihuza uhawe
inguzanyo n’abamuhaye inguzanyo
kigafasha impande zombi kugera ku
masezerano y’inguzanyo, kikuzuza iyo
nshingano kugeza amasezerano
ashyizwe mu bikorwa cyangwa kikaza
gisimbura undi muhuza wabanje;
(u) “umujyanama mu by’inguzanyo”
bivuga umunyamwuga w’inzobere mu
gutanga inama ku bifuza gufata
cyangwa bafashe inguzanyo ku
birebana no gucunga neza inguzanyo
cyangwa gufasha abahawe inguzanyo
kugira ibyo bumvikanaho n’ababahaye
izo nguzanyo;
(v) “umunyamigabane ufite uruhare
rugaragara” bivuga
umunyamigabane mu kigo gitanga
serivisi z’imari kitakira amafaranga
abitswa akaba, haba mu buryo
buziguye cyangwa butaziguye, we ku
giti cye cyangwa afatanyije n’abandi,
afite nibura 5% by’imari shingiro bwite
cyangwa by’uburenganzira bwo
gutora, cyangwa ufite uruhare
rugaragara mu ifatwa ry’ibyemezo ku
birebana n’uburyo bw’icungwa
ry’ikigo gitanga serivisi z’imari
kitakira amafaranga abitswa;
(w)“uri mu buyobozi bukuru” bivuga
abakozi b’ingenzi bo mu buyobozi
bukuru bashinzwe imicungire ya buri
munsi y’abatanga serivisi z’imari
batakira amafaranga abitswa, harimo –
(i) umuyobozi mukuru (CEO/MD)
umuyobozi ;
(ii) abakozi bo ku rwego rwo hejuru
batanga raporo ku Nama
y’Ubuyobozi cyangwa kuri
komite z’Inama y’Ubuyobozi;
(iii) abakozi bo ku rwego rwo hejuru
batanga raporo ku muyobozi
mukuru (CEO/MD);
(x) “utanga serivisi z’imari” bivuga
utanga serivisi z’imari atakira
amafaranga abitswa n’uwakira
amafaranga abitswa nk’uko
basobanurwa mu mabwiriza agenga
buri wese;
(y) “utanga serivisi z’imari atakira
amafaranga abitswa” bivuga ikigo
gifite ubuzima gatozi uretse uwakira
amafaranga abitswa wahawe na Banki
Nkuru uruhushya rwo gutanga “serivisi
z’imari” nk’uko zasobanuwe muri aya
mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Abarebwa n’aya mabwiriza (1) Aya mabwiriza areba abatanga serivisi z’imari batakira amafaranga abitswa
articles.text:
basobanurwa muri aya mabwiriza n’undi
wese utanga serivisi z’imari atakira
A
amafaranga abitswa akaba atagengwa
n’irindi tegeko cyangwa amabwiriza.
(2) Aya mabwiriza ntareba abagurisha
ibicuruzwa byabo ariko kwishyura bikaba
biteganyijwe nyuma y’igihe.

articles.heading: Ibyiciro by’abatanga serivisi z’imari batakira amafaranga abitswa (1) Abatanga serivisi z’imari batakira
Gusaba uruhushya (1) Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi gishaka gutanga serivisi z’imari nk’utanga serivisi
articles.text:
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
kibisaba Banki Nkuru mu nyandiko.
(2) Ikigo gifite ubuzima gatozi gishobora
gusaba uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi
z’imari nk’ikigo gitanga serivisi z’imari
kitakira amafaranga abitswa muri kimwe
mu byiciro biteganyijwe muri aya
mabwiriza.
(3) Usaba uruhushya asobanura ku buryo
bwuzuye buri serivisi ateganya gutanga
bitewe n’icyiciro yahisemo.
(4) Usaba uruhushya rwo gukora nk’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa ashyikiriza Banki Nkuru ifishi
y’ubusabe bw’uruhushya iri ku mugereka
wa I w’aya mabwiriza.
(5) Ibaruwa y’ubusabe iherekezwa
n’inyandiko zikurikira:
(a) ifishi y’amakuru yujujwe kuri buri
munyamigabane ufite uruhare
rugaragara, buri wese mu bari mu
buyobozi bukuru cyangwa mu bagize
Inama y’Ubuyobozi iri ku mugereka
wa II w’aya mabwiriza;
(b) imiterere y’imari shingiro iteganyijwe
harimo ubwoko bw’imigabane, uko
imigabane isaranganyijwe
n’imyirondoro yuzuye
y’abanyamigabane;
(c) aderesi y’ahantu icyicaro giteganyijwe
n’iy’ahakorerwa ubucuruzi
hateganyijwe;
(d) gahunda y’ibikorwa ikubiyemo
iteganyabikorwa, uburyo bw’imikorere
y’ibikorwa n’ibigereranyo by’imari
iteganyijwe kwinjira nibura mu gihe
cy’imyaka itatu, harimo
n’ibyashingiweho mu kugena ibyo
bigereranyo;
(e) icyemezo cy’ishingwa ry’ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi;
(f) inyandiko y’ubwumvikane;
(g) ku usaba w’umunyamahanga, ibaruwa
y’urwego rw’ubugenzuzi rwo mu
gihugu akomokamo imwemerera
gushyiraho ikigo kimushamikiyeho
cyangwa ishami mu Rwanda, hamwe
n’icyemezo cy’urwo rwego kigaragaza
ko rukora ubugenzuzi bwe
n’ubw’amashami ye aho ari hose, aho
biri ngombwa;
(h) kopi iriho umukono wa noteri
y’imyanzuro w’abanyamuryango yo
gushyiraho ikigo gitanga serivisi
z’imari kitakira amafaranga abitswa;
(i) politiki n’amabwiriza ngenderwaho;
(j) icyemezo kigaragaza ko usaba
uruhushya rwo gukora nk’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa afite imari shingiro itagibwa
munsi isabwa;
(k) inyandiko yemeza ko amafaranga
yashowe adakomoka ku bikorwa
binyuranyije n’amategeko nkuko
bisobanurwa ku mugereka wa III
w’aya mabwiriza;
(l) andi makuru yose Banki Nkuru
ishobora kubona ko ari ngombwa mu
rwego rwo gusuzuma ubusabe.
(6) Gutanga amakuru y’ibinyoma cyangwa
ayobya ni impamvu yo kwanga ubusabe
bwo kwemererwa uruhushya cyangwa
kwamburwa uruhushya rwatanzwe.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa byihariye bireba utanga inguzanyo mu buryo koranabuhanga Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
articles.text:
abitswa ufite uruhushya ushaka gutanga
serivisi z’inguzanyo mu buryo koranabuhanga,
ashyikiriza Banki Nkuru ibi bikurikira:
(a) ibisobanuro birambuye ku mabwiriza
arebana n’inguzanyo na serivisi ateganya
gutanga;
(b) ibisobanuro birambuye ku
ikoranabuhanga mu itangazabumenyi
n’itumanaho riteganyijwe gukoreshwa
mu bikorwa by’utanga inguzanyo mu
buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga;
(c) amasezerano n’isosiyete y’itumanaho
cyangwa undi utanga serivisi ku bijyanye
no guhabwa imiyoboro cyangwa imbuga
byo kwifashisha mu gutanga inguzanyo
mu buryo koranabuhanga;
(d) politiki n’amabwiriza ngenderwaho
utanga inguzanyo mu buryo
koranabuhanga ateganya mu kurinda
amakuru;
(e) politiki n’amabwiriza ngenderwaho
utanga inguzanyo mu buryo
koranabuhanga ateganya mu rwego rwo
kurwanya ibikorwa by’iyezandonke
n’ibyo gutera inkunga iterabwoba;
(f) politiki y’inguzanyo, imyitwarire iboneye
y’umwuga.

articles.heading: Amafaranga y’ubusabe adasubizwa Usaba uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’imari atakira amafaranga abitswa yishyura
Imari shingiro itagibwa munsi (1) Imari shingiro yishyuwe itagibwa munsi k’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa iri mu buryo
bukurikira:
(a) 500,000,000 FRW k’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa uri mu cyiciro cya I;
(b) 200,000,000 FRW k’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa uri mu cyiciro cya II;
(c) nta mari shingiro itagibwa munsi
isabwa ku batanga serivisi z’imari
batakira amafaranga abitswa bari
mu cyiciro cya III.
(2) Imari shingiro itagibwa munsi ivugwa
mu gika cya (1) ishobora kuba iri mu
buryo bw’amafaranga cyangwa mu
buryo bw’indi mitungo ifite agaciro,
ariko imari shingiro iri mu yindi
mitungo ifite agaciro ntigomba
kurenga 30% by’igiteranyo cy’imari
shingiro itagibwa munsi yose isabwa.
(3) Iyo imari shingiro iri mu buryo
bw’amafaranga, ayo mafaranga
A
ashyirwa kuri konti ntakorwaho mu
gihe runaka iri muri banki cyangwa mu
kigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
amafaranga abitswa bikorera mu
Rwanda kandi usaba uruhushya
ashyikiriza Banki Nkuru icyemezo
cy’uko yabikije ayo mafaranga mbere
yo guhabwa uruhushya rwuzuye.
(4) Iyo igice cy’imari shingiro kiri mu
buryo bw’indi mitungo ifite agaciro,
usaba ashyikiriza Banki Nkuru
ikimenyetso cyemewe mu rwego
rw’amategeko kigaragaza ko iyo mari
shingiro yanditse ku mazina y’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa kandi akanayishyikiriza
gahunda yerekana uburyo uwo
mutungo uzagurishwa ukavamo
amafaranga cyangwa ibintu
byahindurwamo amafaranga ku buryo
bworoshye cyangwa uburyo uwo
mutungo uzakoreshwa mu bikorwa
by’abatanga serivisi z’imari batakira
amafaranga abitswa.
(5) Imari shingiro yishyuwe itagibwa
munsi iguma muri banki cyangwa mu
mu kigo cy’imari iciriritse cyakira
amafaranga abitswa kugeza igihe
ubusabe bwemewe cyangwa
butemewe.
(6) Usaba uruhushya agaragaza ko afite
ubushobozi bwo kugumana mu buryo
buhoraho imari shingiro itagibwa
munsi uko isabwa n’urwego
rw’ubugenzuzi no kubahiriza buri gihe
ikigero cy’imari shingiro ihagije
cyagenwe.
(7) Usaba uruhushya atanga inyandiko
zisobanura inkomoko y’amafaranga
agize imari shingiro.
(8) Banki Nkuru ishobora kuzamura
igipimo cy’imari shingiro iyo utanga
serivisi utakira amafaranga abitswa
akeneye guhuza ibikorwa by’ibyiciro
birenze kimwe cyangwa bitewe n’indi
mpamvu iyo ari yo yose.

articles.heading: Kumenyesha iyakirwa ry’ubusabe (1) Banki Nkuru imenyesha usaba uruhushya ko yakiriye ubusabe bwe
articles.text:
mu gihe cy’iminsi 10 y’akazi ibarwa
uhereye ku munsi yakiriyeho ubusabe
bwe. Banki Nkuru ishobora kumusaba
gutanga amakuru y’inyongera
cyangwa amakuru abura, cyangwa
gukosora amakosa agaragara mu
busabe.
(2) Usaba uruhushya atanga amakuru
y’inyongera, abura cyangwa agakosora
amakosa agaragara mu busabe mu gihe
cy’iminsi 30 y’akazi ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki Banki Nkuru yabimusabiye. Iyo
icyo gihe kirenze adatanze amakuru
y’inyongera, abura cyangwa
adakosoye amakosa agaragara mu
busabe, ubusabe bw’uruhushya
buteshwa agaciro. Icyakora, Banki
Nkuru ishobora kongera icyo gihe iyo
ibisabwe n’usaba uruhushya.

articles.heading: Icyemezo cya Banki Nkuru Banki Nkuru isuzuma ubusabe igafata icyemezo cyo gutanga cyangwa kudatanga
articles.text:
uruhushya mu gihe cy’iminsi 30 y’akazi
ibarwa uhereye igihe yakiriyeho dosiye
yuzuye y’ubusabe. Iyo Banki Nkuru itanze
uruhushya, itanga icyemezo cy’uruhushya. Iyo
idatanze uruhushya, imenyesha usaba
uruhushya impamvu zatumye adahabwa
uruhushya.

articles.heading: Igihe uruhushya rumara n’ahantu rumanikwa (1) Uruhushya rutanzwe rukomeza kugira agaciro keretse iyo ruhagaritswe
articles.text:
by’agateganyo cyangwa rugateshwa
agaciro na Banki Nkuru ku mpamvu
ziteganyijwe muri aya mabwiriza.
(2) Icyemezo cy’uruhushya cyatanzwe
kimanikwa buri gihe ahantu hagaragara
ku cyicaro gikuru cy’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
bireba, kandi kopi zacyo zigashyirwa
ahantu hagaragara aho ari ho hose
akorera ubucuruzi.

articles.heading: Kwemererwa gutangira gukora (1) Iyo usaba uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’imari atakira amafaranga
articles.text:
amaze kuzuza igice kinini cy’ibisabwa
mu guhabwa uruhushya, Banki Nkuru
ishobora gufata icyemezo cyo
kumwemerera gutangira ibikorwa bye
mu gihe hagitegerejwe ko ibisabwa
byose byuzuzwa.
(2) Kwemererwa gutangira ibikorwa
guteganywa mu gika cya (1)
ntigushobora kurenza amezi 12. Iyo
icyo gihe kirenze hataraboneka
uruhushya rwuzuye, Banki Nkuru
ishobora gutesha agaciro icyo cyemezo
cyo kwemererwa gutangira gukora.

articles.heading: Isosiyete y’ubucururi yo mu mahanga isaba uruhushya mu Rwanda (1) Isosiyete y’ubucuruzi yo mu mahanga
articles.text:
ishobora gusaba uruhushya rwo
gutanga serivisi z’imari nk’utakira
amafaranga abitswa binyuze mu
isosiyete iyishamikiyeho cyangwa mu
ishami ryayo mu Rwanda.
(2) Hiyongereye ku bisabwa bivugwa mu
ngingo ya 5 y’aya mabwiriza, isosiyete
y’ubucuruzi yo mu mahanga yifuza
gutanga serivisi z’imari itakira
amafaranga abitswa binyuze mu
isosiyete iyishamikiyeho cyangwa mu
ishami ryayo itanga izindi nyandiko
z’inyongera zikurikira:
(a) ibaruwa y’urwego rw’ubugenzuzi
rwo mu gihugu cye yemeza ko
rushyigikiye ko yashyiraho
isosiyete imushamikiyeho
cyangwa ishami mu Rwanda, igihe
ari ngombwa;
(b) icyemezo cy’urwego
rw’ubugenzuzi rwo mu gihugu cye
kigaragaza ko rwiyemeje gukora
ubugenzuzi bwe n’ubw’amashami
bukomatanyije;
(c) andi makuru yose Banki Nkuru
ishobora kubona ko akenewe mu
gusuzuma ry’ubusabe.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ibikorwa cyangwa
impinduka bikenera kubanza kwemerwa na
Banki Nkuru

articles.heading: Kwemeza abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’abari mu buyobozi (1) Abajya mu myanya y’abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi, iy’abari mu Buyobozi
articles.text:
by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa bemezwa na Banki
Nkuru.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa aha Banki Nkuru
amakuru yerekeranye na buri wese
ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’uri mu
Buyobozi mu minsi 30 ibarwa uhereye
igihe ahinduwe cyangwa ashyizweho
kandi ayo makuru agomba kuba
akubiyemo ibintu byose bifasha Banki
Nkuru gusuzuma ubushobozi,
ubunyamugayo n’imico myiza bye.
(3) Nyuma yo kwakira dosiye y’ubusabe
yuzuye, Banki Nkuru imenyesha
utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 y’akazi ugize Inama
y’Ubuyobozi, uri mu buyobozi yemeye
n’uwo itemeye.

articles.heading: Gufungura ahantu hakorerwa ubucuruzi (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ufite uruhushya
articles.text:
ashobora gufungura ahantu hakorerwa
ubucuruzi abanje kubihererwa
uburenganzira na Banki Nkuru.
(2) Ubusabe bwo gufungura ahantu
hakorerwa ubucuruzi bushyikirizwa
Banki Nkuru mu nyandiko
bukubiyemo ibi bikurikira:
(a) aho ubucuruzi buzakorerwa
n’ubwoko bw’ibikorwa
biteganyijwe;
A
(b) inyigo y’isesengura ry’ibikorwa
biteganyijwe ikubiyemo
ibigereranyo by’imari yitezwe mu
gihe cy’imyaka ibiri nibura;
(c) imiterere y’inzego z’imirimo
igaragaza abakozi bateganyijwe
kuzakorera aho hantu h’ubucurizi;
(d) icyemezo kigaragaza ko Banki
Nkuru yishyuwe amafaranga
y’ubusabe adasubizwa angana na
50.000 FRW.
(3) Iyo inyandiko zose zisabwa zuzuye,
Banki Nkuru ifata icyemezo mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi 30 y’akazi.

articles.heading: Iyegukana, ukwibumbira hamwe cyangwa ikomatanya (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa wifuza
articles.text:
kwegukanwa, kwibumbira hamwe
n’undi cyangwa kwikomatanya
n’undi, abanza kubisabira
uburenganzira muri Banki Nkuru.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa usaba uruhushya
rwo kwegukanwa, kwibumbira hamwe
n’undi cyangwa kwikomatanya n’undi
ashyikiriza Banki Nkuru inyandiko
zikurikira:
(a) ibaruwa y’ubusabe yandikiwe
Banki Nkuru;
(b) imyanzuro y’abanyamuryango
yemeza iryo yegukana,
ukwibumbira hamwe cyangwa
ikomatanya;
(c) amasezerano y’iyegukana,
ay’ukwibumbira hamwe cyangwa
ay’ikomatanya;
(d) uburyo bwerekana uko hazabaho
kubyara inyungu n’inyigo
y’isesengura ry’ibikorwa
biteganyijwe ikubiyemo
ibigereranyo by’imari yitezwe
y’ibigo bishya byakomotse ku
iyegukana, ukwibumbira hamwe
cyangwa ikomatanywa mu gihe
cy’imyaka itatu nibura;
(e) gahunda iteganyijwe y’imiterere
y’imigabane n’imbonerahamwe
n’imiterere y’inzego z’imirimo
y’ikigo cyakomotse ku iyegukana,
ukwibumbira hamwe cyangwa
ikomatanywa.
(3) Iyo ibisabwa byuzuye, Banki Nkuru
ifata icyemezo mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 y’akazi.
(4) Iyo Banki Nkuru yanze ubusabe
bw’Iyegukana, ukwibumbira hamwe
cyangwa ikomatanya, imenyesha mu
nyandiko, usaba icyo cyemezo
n’impamvu yabyo.

articles.heading: Imiterere y’imigabane Umuntu ku giti cye cyangwa ikigo gifite ubuzima gatozi bishobora kugira imigabane
articles.text:
kugeza ku kigero cya 100% mu kigo cy’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa.

articles.heading: Kwegukana cyangwa gutanga imigabane (1) Kwegukana cyangwa gutanga imigabane igize uruhare rugaragara byemerwa na
articles.text:
Banki Nkuru imaze gushyikirizwa
inyandiko zisabwa zivugwa mu mugereka
wa II.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa kandi amenyesha Banki Nkuru
iyongerwa ry’imigabane rikozwe
n’abanyamigabane asanzwe afite.
(3) Umuntu wakoze amakosa yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi mu kigo cy’imari
ntiyemerewe kugira imigabane mu kigo
cy’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa keretse iyo
ahanaguweho ubusembwa na Banki
Nkuru.

articles.heading: Inkomoko y’amafaranga akoreshwa mu bikorwa by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
articles.text:
(1) Amafaranga akoreshwa mu bikorwa
by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ashobora
gukomoka ahantu hanyuranye, harimo
–
(a) amafaranga y’abanyamigabane;
(b) amafaranga ava mu bikorwa
n’ahandi hatari mu bikorwa;
(c) inguzanyo;
(d) impano n’inkunga.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ntiyemerewe
gukoresha amafaranga akomoka mu
nzira zinyuranyije n’amategeko.

articles.heading: Ubwoko bw’ibigo by’ubucuruzi by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
Gukora ibikorwa by’inyongera Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa akora igikorwa kimwe cyangwa
articles.text:
byinshi yaherewe uruhushya. Iyo akeneye
gukora igikorwa cy’inyongera atari asanzwe
afitiye uruhushya, abisaba Banki Nkuru atanze
inyandiko zikurikira:
(a) ibaruwa y’ubusabe yandikiwe Banki
Nkuru;
(b) imyanzuro y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
cyangwa indi nyandiko nka yo
iyisimbura yemeza ishyirwaho
ry’igikorwa gishya;
(c) kwerekana imiterere y’ubucuruzi
n’uko buzabyara inyungu na politiki
n’amabwiriza ngenderwaho mu
mikorere by’imbere mu kigo bigenga
igikorwa gishya.

articles.heading: Guhuza serivisi z’imari na serivisi zitari iz’imari (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ashobora guhuza
articles.text:
serivisi z’imari n’izindi serivisi zitari
iz’imari zuzuzanya igihe cyose serivisi
z’imari ari zo ziganje mu bucuruzi bwe.
Mu rwego rw’aya Mabwiriza, serivisi
z’imari ziba ziganje mu bucurizi iyo
zigize nibura 70% by’umutungo wose
w’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa.
(2) Iyo serivisi zivugwa mu gika cya (1)
zihujwe, utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ashyikiriza Banki
Nkuru raporo y’ibaruramari yihariye
kuri buri bwoko bwa serivisi atanga na
raporo y’ibaruramari ihurije hamwe
ubwoko bwombi bwa serivisi iz’imari
n’iz’izitari iz’imari atanga.

articles.heading: Inyandiko zikubiyemo ingamba Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa yuzuza kandi agakoresha inyandiko
articles.text:
zikubiyemo ingamba z’imikorere ziyobora
ibikorwa bye by’ubucuruzi mu buryo
bukurikira:
(a) gahunda z’ingamba, gahunda
z’ibikorwa byavuguruwe
bishyirwamo amakuru ajyanye
n’igihe ndetse n’ingengo y’imari;
(b) politiki n’amabwiriza
ngenderwaho mu mikorere
by’imbere mu kigo bijyanye
n’igihe, harimo politiki
y’imiyoborere n’imicungire
y’abakozi, politiki y’ibanze
y’imikorere y’ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi, politiki
y’ishoramari, politiki
y’ibaruramari n’iy’imikoreshereze
y’imari n’izindi politiki
n’amabwiriza ngenderwaho mu
mikorere bijyanye n’ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi;
(c) uburyo bw’imicungire y’ibyateza
ingorane;
(d) indi nyandiko ikubiyemo ingamba
Banki Nkuru yabona ko ari
ngombwa.

articles.heading: Gukoresha imirimo abakozi bo hanze y’ikigo (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ashobora
articles.text:
gukoresha imwe mu mirimo cyangwa
bimwe mu bikorwa bye abakozi bo
hanze y’ikigo iyo ibyo bikorwa
bidatuma habaho igongana ry’inyungu
ku bagomba kubikora.
(2) Ikoresha ryose ry’abakozi bo hanze
y’ikigo mu mirimo cyangwa ibikorwa
by’ingenzi by’utanga serivisi z’imari
utakira amafaranga abitswa risaba ko
ryemerwa na Banki Nkuru. Icyakora,
utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ntashobora
gukoresha umuntu wo hanze y’ikigo
mu mirimo y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi
cyangwa mu mirimo y’Umuyobozi
Mukuru.
(3) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa usaba
kwemererwa gukoresha abantu bo
hanze y’ikigo cye ashyikiriza Banki
Nkuru inyandiko zikurikira:
A
(a) ibaruwa y’ubusabe yandikiwe
Banki Nkuru;
(b) amakuru ajyanye na serivisi yifuza
gukoresha abantu bo hanze, harimo
abo yifuza gukoresha n’uburyo
bazacunga iyo serivisi;
(c) isesengura ry’ikiguzi bizatwara mu
gukoresha abantu bo hanze mu
gutanga iyo serivisi n’inyungu
izaba irimo;
(d) raporo y’ibyagaragajwe ku
bushishozi, ubushobozi,
ubunyangamugayo n’imyitwarire
y’abantu bo hanze b’ibanze
bazakora imirimo y’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa;
(e) andi makuru yose Banki Nkuru
ishobora gusaba.
Icyiciro cya 3: Kwimurira cyangwa gufunga
igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi no guhindura izina

articles.heading: Kwimurira igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi ahandi cyangwa gufunga ahantu hakorerwa icyo bikorwa (1) utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
articles.text:
amafaranga ashobora kwimurira
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi ahandi cyangwa
gufunga ahantu hakorerwa ibyo bikorwa.
(2) Kwimurira ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
ahandi cyangwa gufunga ahantu
hakorerwa ibyo bikorwa ntibisaba
uburenganzira bwa Banki Nkuru ariko
utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ibiyimenyesha, mu
nyandiko, mu minsi icumi mbere y’uko
bikorwa.
(3) Iyo habaye kwimurira igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi ahandi cyangwa gufunga
ahantu hakorerwa icyo gikorwa, utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa akura ahantu hakorerwaga ibyo
bikorwa ibirango byagaragazaga ko
hakorerwaga ubwo bucuruzi.

articles.heading: Guhindura izina ry’isosiyete y’ubucuruzi Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa uhinduye izina ry’isosiyete
articles.text:
y’ubucuruzi abimenyesha Banki Nkuru mu
nyandiko.
UMUTWE WA IV: IMIYOBORERE
Y’IKIGO
Icyiciro cya mbere: Inama y’Ubuyobozi

articles.heading: Abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’ibyo basabwa (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa agomba kugira
articles.text:
nibura abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi
batatu, harimo nibura babiri badafite
inshingano z’imicungire ye ya buri
munsi mu kigo kiri mu cyiciro cya I,
n’umwe nibura udafite inshingano
z’imicungire ye ya buri munsi igihe ari
ikigo cyo mu cyiciro cya II, kandi 2/3
muri bo bagomba kuba bafite
impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya kabiri
cya kaminuza mu bijyanye
n’imicungire y’ubucuruzi. Iyo ari ikigo
cyo mu cyiciro cya III, imiterere
y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’abayigize
byagaragajwe mu iyandikwa cyangwa
ishingwa ry’isosiyete y’ubucuruzi
nibyo byitabwaho.
(2) Iyo uri mu nama y’ubuyobozi y’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswe aba mu mahanga, agaragaza
uburyo azajya yuzuza inshingano ze
nk’umwe mu bagize Inama
y’Ubuyobozi.
(3) Uri mu Nama y’Ubuyobozi ashobora
kujya mu nama z’ubuyobozi
z’abatanga serivisi z’imari barenze
umwe. Icyakora, atangariza Banki
Nkuru ko kuba umwe mu bagize Inama
z’Ubuyobozi y’ibyo bigo bidashobora
kuba intandaro y’igongana ry’inyungu.
(4) Umukozi uhoraho ukora mu rwego
rw’amabanki cyangwa rw’ibigo
by’imari iciriritse ufite ishingano
zijyanye no gutanga inguzanyo
ntashobora kuba umwe mu bagize
Inama y’Ubuyobozi y’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa.

articles.heading: Inshingano n’amabwiriza ngengamikorere by’Inama y’Ubuyobozi Inshingano n’andi mabwiriza ngengamikorere
articles.text:
y’Inama y’Ubuyobozi biteganywa mu
nyandiko y’amahame n’amabwiriza
ngenderwaho y’inama y’ubuyobozi y’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa.

articles.heading: Komite z’Inama y’Ubuyobozi Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ashobora gushyiraho komite z’Inama
articles.text:
y’Ubuyobozi.
Section 2: Ubuyobozi

articles.heading: Abagize Ubuyobozi ku cyiciro cya I n’icya II n’ibyo basabwa (1) Ubuyobozi bw’utanga serivisi z’imari
articles.text:
utakira amafaranga abitswa bukorwa
n’Umuyobozi Mukuru. Umuyobozi
Mukuru agomba kuba afite
impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro cya mbere
cy’amashuri makuru mu micungire
y’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi, ibaruramari,
ubukungu cyangwa mu bindi bifitanye
isano n’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
by’utanga serivisi z’imari atakira
amafaranga abitswa.
(2) Umuyobozi Mukuru agomba kuba
nibura afite uburambe bw’imyaka ibiri
bujyanye no kuzuza inshingano
zijyanye n’ibikorwa by’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa,
cyangwa uburambe mu rwego rw’imari
cyangwa mu bindi bushobora
kumufasha mu gucunga ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi by’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa.
(3) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa uri mu cyiciro cya
I n’icya II ashyiraho abakozi bahagije
bitewe n’imiterere n’urusobe
rw’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi akora.
Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa agomba kugira
abakozi b’ingenzi nibura mu myanya
y’imirimo y’ibanze ikurikira:
(a) imari n’ibaruramari;
(b) inguzanyo;
(c) undi mwanya w’umurimo wa
ngombwa.
(4) Abakozi bakuriye imyanya y’imirimo
y’ibanze y’utanga serivisi z’imari
utakira amafaranga abitswa, nk’uko
isobanurwa mu mbonerahamwe
y’imyanya y’imirimo, bagomba kuba
bafite nibura impamyabumenyi
y’icyiciro cya mbere cy’amashuri
makuru ndetse n’uburambe mu kuzuza
inshingano zifitanye isano n’izo mu
myanya y’imirimo bakuriye.
(5) Inshingano, uburyo bw’imikorere
n’ubumenyi abakozi bagomba kuba
bafite, bisobanurwa muri politiki
y’imicungire y’abakozi ndetse no mu
nyandiko igaragaza ibyo abakozi
bashyirwa mu myanya y’imirimo
bagomba kuba bujuje.
(6) Nta muntu ushobora kuba umukozi
w’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa igihe agikorera
ikindi kigo cy’imari icyo ari cyo cyose.

articles.heading: Ubuyobozi ku cyiciro cya III Amabwiriza yihariye ashobora kugena imiterere y’ubuyobozi bw’abatanga serivisi
articles.text:
z’imari batakira amafaranga abitswa bari mu
cyiciro cya III.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’Ubuyobozi (1) Ubuyobozi – (a) bukora ku buryo ibikorwa by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa bikorwa
hubahirizwa ingamba z’ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi, ibyateza ingorane
yiyemeje kwihanganira na politiki
zemejwe n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi.
(b) bukora ku buryo abakozi bahabwa
amahugurwa ahagije kandi
bashoboye gukora imirimo yabo no
kuzuza inshingano zabo.
(2) Abari mu buyobozi bafite
impamyabushobozi za kinyamwuga
bakomeza guhabwa amahugurwa
abafasha kunguka ubumenyi. Icyakora,
abari mu buyobozi badafite
impamyabumenyi za kinyamwuga
bahabwa amahugurwa ku buryo
buhoraho ajyanye n’inshingano zabo.
(3) Ubuyobozi bufite inshingano yo
gukora ku buryo hafatwa ingamba
zikwiye kandi ku gihe hakurikijwe
ibyagaragajwe byose n’ubugenzuzi
bw’imari bwo mu kigo ndetse
n’ibyifuzonama byose bitanzwe mu
rwego rw’ubwo bugenzuzi.

articles.heading: Gukura mu nshingano abakozi bo mu buyobozi Inama y’Ubuyobozi ifite ububasha bwo gukura mu nshingano igihe icyo ari cyo cyose,
articles.text:
umuntu wese uri mu bayobozi bo hejuru mu
kigo cy’utanga serivisi z’imari atakira
amafaranga abitswa, iyo hari amakuru
y’imyitwarire idakwiye yigeze kumuranga
amenyekanye nyuma cyangwa iyo akora mu
buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko
n’amabwiriza abigenga, cyangwa se igihe
akora mu buryo bubangamiye cyangwa
budashyira imbere inyungu z’abaturage muri
rusange.
Icyiciro cya 3: Ingingo zihuriweho ku Nama
y’Ubuyobozi n’Ubuyobozi

articles.heading: Ibisabwa bijyanye n’ubunyamwuga n’ubunyangamugayo (1) Ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’uri mu buyobozi by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa agomba kuba yujuje
ibisabwa bijyanye no kuba umunyakuri no
kuba inyangamugayo. Ibi birimo –
(a) kuba umuntu atarakatiwe burundu igihano
cy’igifungo kingana cyangwa kirengeje
amezi atandatu mu rubanza rwabaye
ndakuka;
(b) kuba nta makuru mabi amwerekeye ku
makosa yakoze mu bijyanye n’ishoramari
cyangwa ubucuruzi;
(c) kubahiriza ibisabwa n’amabwiriza
cyangwa ibipimo ngenderwaho;
(d) kuba ataragize uruhare mu myitwarire
mibi, kurenga ku mategeko cyangwa
amabwiriza, cyangwa mu kindi gikorwa
kinyuranyije n’amategeko cyatumye
isosiyete y’ubucuruzi, ubufatanye
cyangwa undi muryango bihagarikwa
cyangwa byamburwa uruhushya, bisibwa
mu gitabo cy’iyandikisha, cyangwa
bifatirwa ibindi bihano n’urwego
ngenzuramikorere cyangwa urwego
rubifitiye ububasha;
(e) umuntu nta ruhare yigeze agira mu ikosa,
imiyoborere mibi, cyangwa kurenga ku
mategeko n’amabwiriza byatumye
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bihomba, biseswa,
bihabwa umucungamutungo cyangwa
bishyirwaho imicungire yihariye yo
kubivana ku isoko;
(f) umuntu atarigeze yirukanwa ku kazi,
avanwa ku mwanya, cyangwa ngo yegure
mu gihe yari ari gukorwaho iperereza
kubera imyitwarire mibi mu rwego
rw’imari;
(2) Abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’abari mu
buyobozi by’Utanga serivisi z’imari
utakira amafaranga abitswa bagomba
kugira ubumenyi n’ubushobozi bukwiye,
harimo –
(a) kuba afite impamyabumenyi, ubumenyi
n’uburambe mu bikorwa by’imari
bifitanye isano n’imiterere, ingano
n’ubusobe bw’ibikorwa by’Utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa;
(b) kuba afite amahugurwa y’umwuga akwiye,
ubumenyi bwa tekiniki, n’ubushobozi bwo
gukomeza kwiteza imbere mu mwuga,
bijyanye n’inshingano n'imirimo
ateganyijwe gukora ;
(c) kuba afite igihe gihagije, kandi akiyemeza
kurangiza neza inshingano n’imirimo
ateganyirijwe gukora ;
(3) Abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’abari mu
buyobozi by’Utanga serivisi z’imari
utakira amafaranga abitswa bagaragaza ko
bahagaze neza mu rwego rw’imari.
Isesengura rireba ibikubiyemo –
(a) kuba nta mwenda utishyurwa neza afite
cyangwa indi nshingano y’amafaranga
itarishyurwa;
(b) kuba ataragaragaweho igihombo cyangwa
udashobora kwishyura imyenda ;
(c) kuba nta mwenda afite ukomoka ku
rubanza rwaciwe n’urukiko, umwanzuro
w’ubukemurampaka cyangwa indi
nshingano itegetswe n’amategeko
utarishyurwa ;
(d) adafite amateka yo kutubahiriza
inshingano z’amafaranga cyangwa gukora
amakosa bigaruka kenshi;
(e) adafite imitungo yafatiriwe, yanyazwe
biturutse ku myitwarire itemewe cyangwa
kutubahiriza amategeko;
(f) adafite imyenda y’imisoro itarakemuwe
cyangwa agaragaweho kutubahiriza
inshingano z’imisoro mu buryo bugaruka
kenshi;
(g) kuba nta mpamvu z’ubukungu zihari ku
zatuma afata ibyemezo bidakwiye,
byamushyira ku nkeke, igongana
ry’inyungu, cyangwa bakabangamira
imitekerereze ye mu byemezo.
(4) Ku munyamigabane, agomba kuba –
(a) ashoboye kwishyura imyenda ye igeze
igihe cyo kwishyurwa kandi raporo
y’amakuru ku myenda ye idafite icyasha ;
(b) nta mwenda afite ategekwa n’urubanza
cyangwa ikindi cyemezo kwishyura ukaba
utarishyurwa cyangwa utarishyuwe mu
gihe gitegetswe;
(c) kuba atarakoze ikosa mu isosiyete
y’ubucuruzi, ubufatanye cyangwa undi
muryango byatumye yaburwa uruhushya
cyangwa rugaseswa, cyangwa yirukanywe
n’urwego ngenzuramikorere cyangwa
urwego rwa Leta;
(d) niba ari ikigo cy’imari, yubahirije ibisabwa
mu rwego rw’ubushobozi bwo kwishyura;
(e) n’ibindi bisabwa Banki Nkuru ibona ko ari
ngombwa.

articles.heading: Gushyirwa ku rutonde rw’abafite ubusembwa (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa amenyesha Banki
articles.text:
Nkuru amazina n’aderesi zuzuye,
harimo nimero y’indangamuntu
y’umunyamigabane, ugize Inama
y’Ubuyobozi, uri mu buyobozi bukuru
cyangwa umukozi wanyereje
umutungo, wakoze uburiganya,
waranzwe n’imicungire mibi cyangwa
wakoze ikindi cyaha cyose cyangwa
waranzwe n’imiyoborere mibi
cyangwa ubushobozi buke mu kigo
cye. Ubushobozi buke buvugwa muri
iyi ngingo ntibureba umunyamigabane.
(2) Itangwa ry’urutonde hamwe
n’inyandiko zihamya ibivugwa ku
bantu bavugwa mu gika cya (1)
rikorwa mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 30
uhereye ku munsi utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
yemerejeho ikosa cyangwa afatiyeho
igihano.
(3) Iyo amakuru yatanzwe n’Utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa amaze gusuzumwa kandi
bigaragara ko asobanura impamvu icyo
cyemezo cyafashwe, Banki Nkuru y’u
Rwanda ishyira umuntu bireba ku
rutonde rw’abafite ubusembwa.

articles.heading: Kudakoresha abari ku rutonde rw’abafite ubusembwa Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
articles.text:
abitswa ntashobora kugena, gushyiraho,
kwemerera cyangwa gukoresha ugize Inama
y’Ubuyobozi, uri mu buyobozi bukuru,
umunyamigabane cyangwa umukozi uri ku
rutonde rw’abafite ubusembwa, keretse iyo
yakuweho ubusembwa na Banki Nkuru.

articles.heading: Ihanagurabusembwa (1) Umuntu wese wirukanywe na Banki Nkuru cyangwa n’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
articles.text:
bitewe n’amakosa yo mu rwego
rw’imari cyangwa imyitwarire mibi yo
mu rwego rw’imari, ku buryo aba
atacyujuje ubunyangamugayo
n’ubushobozi bisabwa, ashobora
gukurwaho ubwo busembwa na Banki
Nkuru nyuma y’imyaka itanu ibarwa
uhereye igihe yahereweigihano.
(2) Ihanagurabusembwa nyuma y’igihano
cyakomotse ku myitwarire mibi kitari
ukwirukanwa rikorwa nyuma
y’imyaka itatu ibarwa uhereye ku
irangira ry’igihano igihe bishoboka,
cyangwa uhereye ku imenyekana
ry’impamvu yatumye afatwa
nk’utacyujuje ubunyangamugayo
n’ubushobozi bisabwa.
(3) Ibiteganywa mu gika cya (2) bireba
n’abakozi beguye ku mirimo yabo
igihe utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa yari agikora
iperereza ku byerekeranye
n’imyitwarire yabo, kandi iryo
perereza rikaba ryarabahamije ibyo
bari bakurikiranyweho.
(4) Uwasubiriye amakosa ashobora gusaba
guhanagurwaho ubusembwa nyuma
y’imyaka icumi avuye mu kigo
cy’imari kubera isubirakosa.

articles.heading: Gusaba guhanagurwaho ubusembwa Ubusabe bwo guhanagurwaho ubusembwa bushyikirizwa Guverineri wa Banki Nkuru mu
articles.text: nyandiko.

articles.heading: Ibigenderwaho mu guhanagura ubusembwa Banki Nkuru ishobora gutanga ihanagurabusembwa nyuma y’uko inyuzwe ku
articles.text:
bisabwa bikurikira:
(a) usaba yishyuye indishyi cyangwa
yasubije iby’abandi nk’uko
byategetswe n’urukiko;
(b) usaba yakomeje kugaragaza
imyitwarire myiza mu gihe
cy’irangizagihano ndetse na nyuma
yaho;
(c) usaba yakoze igihano cyo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi yahawe;
(d) usaba yagaragaje muri dosiye isaba
idosiye igaragaza uburyo
yirukanywemo cyangwa yahawemo
igihano;
(e) ikindi Banki Nkuru yasanga ari
ngombwa.

articles.heading: Icyemezo ku busabe bw’ihanagurabusembwa (1) Banki Nkuru ishobora gutanga ihanagurabusembwa nyuma yo
articles.text:
kugisha inama ibigo bireba ku
byerekeye ikosa ryatumye habaho
kwirukanwa cyangwa guhabwa ikindi
gihano, imaze kunyurwa n’uko usaba
yagaragaje kwicuza kandi akaba
yaragaragaje imyitwarire myiza.
(2) Nyuma yo kumva inama itangwa
n’ibigo bivugwa mu gika cya (1),
Banki Nkuru ishobora kwemera
cyangwa kwanga ihanagurabusembwa.
(3) Nyuma yo kwakira idosiye yuzuye,
Banki Nkuru isesengura ubusabe
bw’ihanagurabusembwa igasubiza
uwasabye mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 30.
(4) Iyo isabwa rya mbere ritemewe kubera
ko igihe giteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 37
kitubahirijwe, gusaba bundi bushya
bitangira igihe cyagenwe gishize.
(5) Icyakora, iyo isabwa
ry’ihanagurabusembwa ritemewe
kubera izindi mpamvu, ntirishobora
kongera gusabwa imyaka ibiri
itarangiye.
UMUTWE WA V: IGENZURA
RY’ABATANGA SERIVISI Z’IMARI
BATAKIRA AMAFARANGA ABITSWA
Icyiciro cya mbere: Inshingano y’igenzura

articles.heading: Inshingano za Banki Nkuru (1) Banki Nkuru ikora buri gihe igenzura ry’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa hagamijwe kureba
niba yubahiriza ibiteganywa n’aya
mabwiriza kimwe n’ibindi
ngenderwaho bishyirwaho na Banki
Nkuru.
(2) Banki Nkuru yuzuza inshingano yayo
y’igenzura ikoresheje uburyo bumwe
cyangwa bwose muri ubu bukurikira:
(a)isesengura ry’inyandiko n’amakuru
bitangwa n’utanga serivisi z’imari
utakira amafaranga abitswa rikorwa
bitabaye ngombwa kujya aho ikigo
gikorera;
(b) igenzura rikorerwa aho utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
akorera;
(c) kugirana inama n’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
zijyanye no kurebera hamwe ingamba
zafashwe ku birebana n’ibyateza
ingorane biriho n’uburyo bwo
kubigabanya;
(d) ubundi buryo bwose bwemewe
n’amategeko Banki Nkuru isanga
bukwiye.
(3) Amafaranga akoreshwa mu kuzuza
inshingano y’ubugenzuzi ya Banki
Nkuru yishyurwa n’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
ugenzurwa hakurikijwe ibiteganywa
n’aya mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Isuzuma rikorerwa n’iridakorerwa aho ikigo kigenzurwa gikorera (1) Isuzuma ry’ibikorwa by’abatanga
articles.text:
serivisi z’imari batakira amafaranga
abitswa rikorerwa aho akorera rikorwa
na Banki Nkuru cyangwa umuntu
yagennye igihe ari cyo cyose, iyo yo
ubwayo ibona ko iryo suzuma
rikenewe mu rwego rwo kumenya uko
bakora ibikorwa byabo.
(2) Isuzuma riba rikubiyemo igenzura
ry’amakuru yatanzwe, kureba
iyubahirizwa ry’ibisabwa, igenzura
ry’imari, igenzura ry’ibitabo,
iry’inyandiko zihurijwe hamwe
n’iry’amadosiye by’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
bifitanye isano n’ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi cyangwa by’imari akora.
Rikubiyemo kandi gufotora ibitabo,
inyandiko zahurijwe hamwe
n’amadosiye cyangwa ibice byabyo
hamwe no kubifatira ndetse no
kubibika aho biba biri mu maboko ya
Banki Nkuru cyangwa y’umuntu
yagennye nyuma yo gutanga gihamya
ko yabyakiriye. Isuzuma rikubiyemo
kandi kubaza ibibazo abagize Inama
y’Ubuyobozi n’abayobozi bo ku rwego
rwo hejuru b’ikigo.

articles.heading: Igenzura rikomatanyije Banki Nkuru igenzura buri tsinda rigize utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa mu
articles.text:
buryo bukomatanyiriza hamwe ibigo byose
bigize iryo tsinda.

articles.heading: Igenzura ryambukiranya imipaka (1) Iyo isosiyete y’ubucuruzi mbyeyi utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa ashamikiyeho
yahawe icyemezo hakurikijwe aya
mabwiriza ariko ikaba ifite icyicaro mu
mahanga, cyangwa iyo utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
yahawe icyemezo hakurikijwe aya
mabwiriza ariko akaba afite ikigo
kimushamikiyeho, ishami cyangwa
ibiro bimuhagarariye mu mahanga,
Banki Nkuru ishobora kugirana
amasezerano y’ubufatanye n’urwego
rw’ubugenzuzi rwo mu mahanga
bireba mu rwego rwo koroshya
ubugenzuzi bwambukiranya imipaka
n’ihanahana ry’amakuru.
(2) Hakurikijwe amasezerano
y’ubufatanye avugwa mu gika cya (1),
Banki Nkuru igenzura isosiyete
y’ubucuruzi mbyeyi y’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa wo
mu Rwanda, ibigo bimushamikiyeho,
amashami ye n’ibiro bimuhagarariye
bikorera mu mahanga, bitabangamiye
ububasha bw’urwego rw’ubugenzuzi
bw’igihugu birimo.
(3) Abagenzuzi b’urwego rw’ubugenzuzi
rw’igihugu cy’amahanga bashobora
gukorera mu Rwanda inshingano zabo
zijyanye no kugenzura isosiyete
mbyeyi y’utanga serivisi z’imari
utakira amafaranga abitswa ukorera mu
gihugu cyabo, ibigo bimushamikiyeho,
n’ibiro bimuhagarariye, nyuma yo
kubimenyesha Banki Nkuru mu
nyandiko.

articles.heading: Kutabangamira igenzura Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa akuraho inzitizi zose, harimo
articles.text:
kudatanga amakuru cyangwa gutanga amakuru
atuzuye cyangwa kudakorera mu mucyo,
zishobora kubangamira iperereza rikorwa
nyuma y’uko atanze ubusabe bw’uruhushya
cyangwa zikaba zabangamira ikorwa
ry’ubugenzuzi bunoze nyuma yo guhabwa
uruhushya.

articles.heading: Amafaranga y’ubugenzuzi ya buri mwaka (1) Nyuma ya buri mwaka w’ibaruramari, utanga serivisi z’imari atakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa uri mu cyiciro cya
I no mu cyiciro cya II yishyura
amafaranga y’ubugenzuzi angana na
0,05% by’umusaruro mbumbe
wabonetse mu mwaka w’ibaruramari
ushize wemejwe n’umugenzuzi. Aya
mafaranga yishyurwa bitarenze itariki
ya 30 Mata y’umwaka w’ibaruramari
ukurikira ku bari mu cyiciro cya I
n’icya II, n’itariki ya 31 Mutarama ya
buri mwaka ukurikira ku bari mu
cyiciro cya III.
(2) Amafaranga y’ubugenzuzi yishyurwa
hakurikijwe igika cya (1) ntashobora
kujya munsi ya FRW 1.000.000 ku bari
mu cyiciro cya I no munsi ya FRW
500.000 ku bari mu cyiciro cya II.
(3) Amafaranga y’ubugenzuzi ku bari mu
cyiciro cya III ni FRW 100.000.

articles.heading: Raporo y’ubugenzuzi (1) Ibyavuye mu bugenzuzi butandukanye bwakozwe na Banki Nkuru bishyikirizwa Inama y’Ubuyobozi
articles.text:
y’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa kandi bishobora
no gushyikirizwa abagenzuzi bigenga.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ugenzurwa
ashyikiriza Banki Nkuru gahunda
y’ibiteganyijwe gukorwa mu rwego
rwo gushyira mu bikorwa
ibyifuzonama byose byumvikanyweho
A
kandi bikagibwaho impaka hagati ye
n’abahagarariye Banki Nkuru
byashyizwe muri raporo. Gahunda
y’ibiteganijwe gukorwa igaragaza
itariki ntarengwa buri cyifuzonama
kigomba kuba cyashyizwe mu
bikorwa.
(3) Kutubahiriza ibyifuzonama bitanzwe
na Banki Nkuru bishobora gutuma
Banki Nkuru ifata ibyemezo
bigaragaza ibigomba gukorwa mu
rwego rwo gukosora cyangwa igafatira
igihano utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’aya mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Ingamba ku byavuye mu bugenzuzi (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa afata ingamba
articles.text:
zikwiriye Banki Nkuru ibona ko ari
ngombwa kugira ngo akosore igikorwa
icyo ari cyo cyose kitaboneye cyangwa
kinyuranyije n’amategeko cyagaragaye
nyuma y’isuzuma ryatangiwe
uruhushya na Banki Nkuru.
(2) Uruhushya rwahawe utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
rushobora guhagarikwa cyangwa
kuvanwaho na Banki Nkuru iyo ibona
ko icyo gikorwa kitaboneye cyangwa
kinyuranyije n’amategeko kitakosowe
ku buryo bwuzuye nyuma y’irangira
ry’igihe ntarengwa utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
yahawe na Banki Nkuru kugira ngo abe
yagikosoye.

articles.heading: Guha abandi ububasha bwo kugenzura (1) Kugira ngo ibashe kuzuza neza inshingano zayo ngenzuramikorere
articles.text:
n’iz’ubugenzuzi no gukoresha uko
bikwiye ububasha buteganywa muri
aya mabwiriza kandi haseguriwe
imirongo ngenderwaho n’ibisabwa
yagena muri urwo rwego, Banki Nkuru
ishobora, hifashishijwe amasezerano
y’imikoranire, guha undi muntu
ububasha bwayo bwo kugenzura.
(2) Uhawe ububasha agomba kubahiriza
ibikubiye mu masezerano
y’imikoranire, aya mabwiriza, n’indi
mirongo migari ngenderwaho bigenga
abatanga serivisi z’imari batakira
amafaranga abitswa.
Icyiciro cya 2: Gutanga raporo n’ibindi
bisabwa mu rwego rw’ubugenzuzi

articles.heading: Raporo z’imari (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa wese ategura kandi agashyikiriza Banki Nkuru
articles.text:
raporo z’imari ze akurikije amahame
ngenderwaho mu gukora raporo
y’imari asanzwe akurikizwa muri
rusange.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ashyikiriza Banki
Nkuru raporo ngarukagihembwe
bitarenze ku itariki 10 z’ukwezi
gukurikira igihembwe.

articles.heading: Raporo y’imari k’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ubarizwa mu itsinda ahuriyemo n’ibindi
articles.text:
bigo
Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa, ategura raporo z’imari ze bwite igihe
abarizwa mu itsinda ahuriyemo n’ibindi bigo.

articles.heading: Ibipimo by’ingenzi bigaragaza ko ikigo gihagaze neza (1) Banki Nkuru ishobora gusaba utanga
articles.text:
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa kubahiriza ibisabwa
kubahirizwa mu gukumira ihungabana
ry’imari.
(2) Icyakora, mu rwego rw’ubugenzuzi
bw’imikorere bukorwa imbere mu
kigo, utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ashyiraho politiki
ikurikizwa imbere mu kigo
yifashishwa nk’igipimo gifasha
kumenya uko ikigo gihagaze.
(3) Ibipimo bishobora gukoreshwa
bikubiyemo –
(a) ibipimo by’amafaranga ahari;
(b) ibipimo by’ubushobozi bwo
kwishyura imyenda;
(c) ibipimo bigaragaza umutungo
bwite w’ikigo ugereranyije
n’imyenda kibereyemio abandi;
(d) ibipimo by’urwunguko, birimo
inyungu ku migabane n’inyungu ku
mutungo;
(e) ibipimo byo kugenzura ingorane
zijyanye n’imyenda, harimo
igipimo cy’inguzanyo zitishyurwa
neza, umubare ntarengwa
w’amafaranga ashobora kugurizwa
umuntu umwe usaba inguzanyo,
umubare ntarengwa w’amafaranga
ashobora kugurizwa umuntu ufite
aho ahuriye n’ikigo, ibipimo ku
bijyanye no gutanga inguzanyo mu
nzego z’ubukungu.

articles.heading: Ubugenzuzi bwigenga ku Cyiciro cya I n’icya II (1) Uretse gusa igihe aya mabwiriza yaba abigena ukundi, buri wese mu batanga
articles.text:
serivisi z’imari batakira amafaranga
abitswa bari mu Cyiciro cya I
n’Icyiciro cya II akorerwa ubugenzuzi
buri mwaka n’umugenzuzi wigenga uri
ku rutonde rw’abagenzuzi bigenga
bemewe na Banki Nkuru.
(2) Raporo z’imari z’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
zagenzuwe zishyikirizwa Banki Nkuru
bitarenze ku itariki ya 30 Mata
ikurikira umwaka w’imari urangiye.

articles.heading: Izindi raporo
Inyandiko zibikwa n’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa, hashingiwe
ku bwoko bw’icyiciro arimo,
abika ku biro bye zimwe cyangwa
zose muri izi nyandiko zikurikira:
(a) inyandiko zerekeye uruhushya
n’ibyo yemerewe;
(b) gahunda z’igihe kirekire,
iz’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi na
gahunda z’ibikorwa
zivuguruye nyuma yo
kongerwamo andi makuru
mashya;
(c) politiki n’amabwiriza
ngenderwaho by’imbere mu
kigo;
(d) inyandikomvugo z’Inama
y’Ubuyobozi
n’iz’iy’ubuyobozi;
(e) inyandiko z’imari
n’iz’ibaruramari, harimo
ibitabo by’ibaruramari,
inyandiko zerekeye imisoro,
inyandiko zihamya amakuru
atanzwe, n’ibindi;
(f) raporo z’igenzura bwite
ry’imbere;
(g) raporo zishyikirizwa Banki
Nkuru;
(h) inyandiko zerekeye
inguzanyo, harimo inyandiko
zerekeye isabwa
ry’inguzanyo, isesengurwa
n’iyemezwa byazo,
amasezerano y’inguzanyo,
inyandiko zerekeye
ivugururwa ry’inguzanyo,
n’inyandiko zerekeye
iyishyuza ryazo;
(i) raporo ku ishyirwa mu byiciro
ry’inguzanyo: urutonde
rw’abahawe inguzanyo,
ingano y’inguzanyo zatanzwe
n’amatariki zatangiweho,
ingano y’inguzanyo yatanzwe
imaze kwishyurwa n’itariki
yishyuriweho, ingano y’igice
cy’inguzanyo kitari
cyishyurwa, inyungu yatswe
n’ibihano byatanzwe,
amafaranga yazigamwe
yakiyambazwa igihe bibaye
ngombwa;
(j) inyandiko zerekeye ingwate:
ibyemezo by’ingwate ku
nguzanyo, iyo hari ingwate
yatanzwe, amakuru yerekeye
umwishingizi, amakuru
yerekeye iyandikisha
n’iyandukuza by’ingwate;
(k) inyandiko zerekeye abakozi,
harimo inyandiko zerekeye
itangwa ry’akazi, ibisobanuro
ku nshingano z’abakozi,
amategeko ngengamyitwarire
y’abakozi, amasezerano
y’akazi y’abakozi n’izindi
dosiye z’abakozi;
(l) izindi nyandiko
z’ibyumvikanweho n’abandi,
harimo amasezerano
y’inguzanyo, amasezerano
y’ubufatanye mu bucuruzi,
n’ibindi;
(m)izindi nyandiko zifatwa ko ari
ngombwa.
(2) Inyandiko n’amadosiye byose
bigomba kubikwa mu gihe kitari
munsi y’imyaka icumi.

articles.heading: Kugira ibanga Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa agira ibanga ry’amakuru ahawe n’umukiriya, kandi
articles.text:
ntiyemerewe guha ayo makuru undi
muntu igihe cyose umukiriya
atabimuhereye uburenganzira mu
nyandiko.
UMUTWE WA VI: INGINGO ZIHARIYE
KU CYICIRO CYA I N’ICYA II
Icyiciro cya mbere: Imikorere y’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
uri mu cyiciro cya I n’icya II

articles.heading: Abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi n’ibishingirwaho mu kubatoranya (1) Iyo hatoranywa abajya mu Nama
articles.text:
y’Ubuyobozi, hakorwa isesengura
hagamijwe gukora ku buryo abayigize
baba bafite ubumenyi n’uburambe
bitandukanye kandi byuzuzanya mu
byiciro bikurikira:
(a) isesenguramari;
(b) ibirebana n’ubudahungabana
bw’urwego rw’imari;
(c) itegurwa rya raporo z’imari;
(d) ikoranabuhanga mu
itangazabumenyi;
(e) iteganyabikorwa ry’igihe kirekire;
(f) kurwanya ibishobora guteza
ingorane;
(g) amategeko n’amabwiriza mu
rwego rw’imari;
(h) kugira impamyabumenyi y’icyiciro
cya mbere cy’amashuri makuru
cyangwa impamyabushobozi
y’umwuga yemewe;
(i) ubushobozi mu kuyobora
n’ubuzobere mu bikorwa
by’ubucuruzi.
(2) Buri wese mu bagize Inama
y’Ubuyobozi aba yujuje ibisabwa mu
rwego rw’ubunyangamugayo
n’ubushobozi kandi inshingano ze mu
Nama y’Ubuyobozi y’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
zikaba zidashobora kuba intandaro
y’igongana ry’inyungu kuri we.

articles.heading: Ingano ntarengwa y’amafaranga yishyurwa cyangwa yakirwa mu ntoki (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa amenyesha
Banki Nkuru konti za banki ziri
mu mazina y’igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi zikoreshwa mu
bikorwa byose bikozwe.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ntiyemerewe
gutanga cyangwa kwishyurwa
amafaranga y’inguzanyo mu
ntoki. Inguzanyo itangwa
cyangwa ikishyurwa mu buryo
bwo gukura amafaranga kuri konti
yo muri banki yoherezwa ku yindi
konti, mu buryo bwa sheki
cyangwa hifashishijwe ubundi
buryo bw’imyishyuranire
A
bwemewe n’amategeko cyangwa
hakoreshejwe uburyo
koranabuhanga kandi ikigo
gitanga inguzanyo kibika
ikimenyetso cy’ibyo bikorwa byo
gutanga cyangwa kwakira
amafaranga. Icyakora, hashobora
kubaho ibikorwa byo gutanga
cyangwa kwishyurwa amafaranga
mu ntoki iyo umukiriya nta buryo
na bumwe afite muri ubwo buryo
bwemewe, kandi icyo gihe ingano
y’amafaranga atangwa cyangwa
yakirwa mu ntoki ntirenga
100.000 FRW.

articles.heading: Imiterere y’ibiciro (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa agomba, mbere yo
articles.text:
gushyira umukono ku masezerano
y’inguzanyo, gukorera mu mucyo
akagaragaza igiciro gitangwa ku
nguzanyo, bityo akamenyesha uhabwa
inguzanyo ijanisha ry’inyungu n’andi
mafaranga n’ikiguzi bitangwa kuri iyo
nguzanyo.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa agomba guha
uhabwa inguzanyo inyandiko y’amakuru
y’ingenzi yerekeye inguzanyo,
kuyishyiraho umukono no kuyishyira
muri dosiye y’umukiriya yerekeye
inguzanyo ye.

articles.heading: Ibikorwa bibujijwe (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ntiyemerewe kwaka ibikurikira nk’ingwate
articles.text:
y’amafaranga atanzwe nk’inguzanyo:
(a) indangamuntu cyangwa pasiporo;
(b) uruhushya rwo gutwara
ikinyabiziga;
(c) sheki;
(d) amakarita ya ATM n’imibare
y’ibanga y’amakarita ya ATM;
(e) cyangwa indi nyandiko yerekana
umwirondoro cyangwa
ubwenegihugu bya nyirayo.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ntiyemerewe
gufata cyangwa kubika ku biro bye
cyangwa ahandi hantu umutungo
wimukanwa w’uhabwa inguzanyo
kugira ngo uwo mutungo ube ingwate
y’inguzanyo yatanzwe.
(3) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ntiyemerewe
kwakira amafaranga y’abakiriya
abitswa.
(4) Utanga inguzanyo n’uhabwa
inguzanyo ntibemerewe gushyira
umukono ku masezerano bagiranye
bagaragaza ko ari amasezerano
y’ubugure aho kugaragaza ko ari
amasezerano y’inguzanyo.
(5) Utanga inguzanyo ntiyemerewe gusaba
inyungu ifatiye ku nguzanyo fatizo
hiyongereyeho inyungu.
(6) Abatanga inguzanyo ntibemerewe
gutanga inguzanyo mu mafaranga
y’amahanga keretse babiherewe
uburenganzira na Banki Nkuru.
(7) Uruhushya rutangwa ntirushobora
kwegurirwa undi cyangwa
kumwemerera kurukoresha mu izina
ry’uwaruhawe.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ingingo zerekeye imicungire
y’ibyateza ingorane ku nguzanyo

articles.heading: Ishyirwa mu byiciro ry’inguzanyo n’igenwa ry’ingoboka zazo n’ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza gukora
articles.text:
Inguzanyo zatanzwe n’ibindi abakiriya
biyemeza gukora bishyirwa mu byiciro kandi
bigateganyirizwa ingoboka mu buryo
bukurikira:
(a) izisanzwe: inguzanyo zatanzwe
cyangwa ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza
gukora bitagaragaramo ubukererwe
cyangwa ibirarane ku birebana
n’ubwishyu. Igihombo cyakomoka ku

0%;
(b) izikurikiranwa: inguzanyo zatanzwe
cyangwa ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza
gukora zagaragayemo ikirarane nibura
inshuro imwe ku bwishyu bwari
bwitezwe cyangwa ku gice cyabwo

Igihombo cyakomoka ku gice cyazo

(c) izitujuje ibisabwa: inguzanyo

yiyemeza gukora zagaragayemo

20%;

gukora zagaragayemo ikirarane nibura

100%.

articles.heading: Ihindurwa ry’icyiciro cy’inguzanyo (1) Inguzanyo iri mu cyiciro “izikurikiranwa” ihindurirwa icyiciro
articles.text:
igashyirwa mu cyiciro “izisanzwe”
nyuma yo kwishyura ibirarane byose
by’umwenda fatizo hamwe
n’iby’inyungu zijyanye na wo.
(2) Inguzanyo iri mu cyiciro “izitujuje
ibisabwa” ihindurirwa icyiciro
igashyirwa mu cyiciro:
(a) “izikurikiranwa” nyuma yo
kwishyura ibirarane byose
by’umwenda fatizo hamwe
n’iby’inyungu zijyanye na wo;
(b) “izisanzwe” iyo uwahawe
inguzanyo akomeje kubahiriza
ingengabihe y’ubwishyu ku byiciro
bibiri by’ubwishyu bikurikiraho
bikurikiranye uhereye igihe
ahinduriwe icyiciro agashyirwa mu
A
cyiciro “zikurikiranwa”.
(3) Inguzanyo iri mu cyiciro “izitizewe”
ihindurirwa icyiciro igashyirwa mu
cyiciro:
(a) “izitujuje ibisabwa” nyuma yo
kwishyura ibirarane byose
by’umwenda fatizo hamwe
n’iby’inyungu zijyanye na wo;
(b) “izikurikiranwa” iyo uwahawe
inguzanyo yakomeje kubahiriza
ingengabihe y’ubwishyu ku byiciro
bibiri by’ubwishyu bikurikiraho
bikurikiranye uhereye igihe
ahinduriwe icyiciro agashyirwa mu
cyiciro “bigoye kwihanganirwa”.
(c) “izisanzwe” iyo uwahawe inguzanyo
yakomeje kubahiriza ingengabihe
y’ubwishyu ku byiciro bibiri
by’ubwishyu bikurikiraho
bikurikiranye uhereye igihe
ahinduriwe icyiciro agashyirwa mu
cyiciro “byakitonderwa”.
(4) Inguzanyo iri mu cyiciro “ziri mu
gihombo” ihindurirwa icyiciro
igashyirwa mu cyiciro:
(a) zitizewe: nyuma yo kwishyura
ibirarane byose, harimo iby’umwenda
fatizo n’iby’inyungu zijyanye na wo;
(b) “zitujuje ibisabwa” iyo uwahawe
inguzanyo yakomeje kubahiriza
ingengabihe y’ubwishyu ku byiciro
bibiri by’ubwishyu bikurikiraho
bikurikiranye uhereye igihe
ahinduriwe icyiciro agashyirwa mu
cyiciro “byakitonderwa”.
(c) “izikurikiranwa” iyo uwahawe
inguzanyo yakomeje kubahiriza
ingengabihe y’ubwishyu ku byiciro
bibiri by’ubwishyu bikurikiraho
bikurikiranye uhereye igihe
ahinduriwe icyiciro agashyirwa mu
cyiciro “zitujuje ibisabwa”.

articles.heading: Gusiba inguzanyo Bimaze kwemerwa n’Inama y’Ubuyobozi, inguzanyo yagaragayemo ikirarane nibura
articles.text:
inshuro imwe ku bwishyu bwari bwitezwe
cyangwa ku gice cyabwo icyo kirarane kikaba
cyaramaze igihe kitari munsi y’umwaka umwe
mu cyiciro “igihombo”, irandukurwa kandi
ikavanwa mu ifoto y’umutungo,
igashyirirwaho uburyo bwo gukurikira
ubwishyu bwayo.

articles.heading: Isubirwamo ry’ibyiciro by’ibyateza ingorane ku nguzanyo (1) Isubirwamo ry’ibyiciro by’ibyateza
articles.text:
ingorane ku nguzanyo nyuma yuko
hagaragaye ibyateza ingorane bishya
cyangwa birushijeho kugira ubukana
cyangwa nyuma yuko hagaragaye
inenge zitandukanye rikorwa ako
kanya, hatabanje gutegereza isuzuma
ngarukagihe rusange ry’inguzanyo
cyangwa isuzuma ry’inguzanyo
yihariye runaka kandi amakuru
yerekeye iryo subirwamo ashyirwa mu
nyandiko iherekeza raporo
z’ibaruramari.
(2) Iyo utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa afite inguzanyo
zatanzwe n’ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza
gukora zirenze imwe ku mukiriya
umwe, hanyuma hakagaragara
ubukererwe mu kwishyura imwe muri
izo nguzanyo, izindi nguzanyo zose
yahawe ndetse n’izahawe
abanyamuryango bafitanye isano ya
bugufi na we zifatwa nk’iziri mu
bukererwe, bityo zigashyirwa mu
byiciro kandi hakabaho guteganyiriza
igihombo zateza.

articles.heading: Ibuzwa ry’itangwa ry’inguzanyo Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ntiyemerewe gutanga inguzanyo
articles.text:
k’uhabwa inguzanyo ufite inguzanyo ikiri
mu birarane haba muri icyo kigo cye
cyangwa mu kigo cy’undi muntu utanga
serivisi z’imari, igihe cyose atari yishyura
ibirarane byose, harimo iby’umwenda fatizo
n’iby’inyungu zijyanye na wo cyangwa
inguzanyo; keretse iyo uwo mukiriya
yishyuye ibirarane byose, harimo umwenda
fatizo n’inyungu, cyangwa uwo mwenda
ukaba waravuguruwe ugashyirwa mu
byiciro “zisanzwe” cyangwa
“zikurikiranwa”.

articles.heading: Iteganya ry’ingoboka hakurikijwe igipimo mpuzamahanga ngenderwaho mu gutegura raporo z’imari (IFRS 9)
articles.text:
(1) Banki Nkuru ishyiraho amabwiriza
yihariye ajyanye n’iteganya
ry’ingoboka risabwa n’amahame
mpuzamahanga ngenderwaho mu
gutegura raporo z’imari (IFRS 9).
(2) Kugira ngo haboneke amafaranga
ahagije mu iteganya ry’ingoboka ku
bihombo bijyanye n’umutungo,
utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ateganya
amafaranga y’ingoboka ari ku kigero
cyo hejuru asabwa ku rwego
rw’amahame mpuzamahanga
ngenderwaho mu gutegura raporo
z’imari (IFRS 9) n’amafaranga
y’ingoboka ateganyijwe muri aya
mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Ingaruka z’ingwate ku kigega cyo guteganyiriza igihombo cy’inguzanyo Mbere y’iteganya ry’ingoboka ku bihombo
articles.text:
bijyanye n’inguzanyo cyangwa umutungo,
utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa akura muri iyo nguzanyo cyangwa
umutungo agaciro k’ingwate cyangwa
k’ubwishingire byatanzwe kuri iyo
nguzanyo byemewe kandi byujuje ibisabwa,
bikaba kikorwa gusa mu buryo bukurikira:
(a) kugeza ku 100% by’agaciro k’ingwate
y’amafaranga;
(b) kugeza ku 100% by’agaciro
k’inyandiko z’agaciro zitangwa na
Leta na Banki Nkuru;
(c) kugeza ku 100% by’agaciro k’ingwate
zitangwa na banki zikorera mu
Rwanda;
(d) kugeza kuri 60% by’agaciro nyakuri
kagaragazwa n’ibaruramari k’amazu
yo guturamo yatanzweho ingwate
yakorewe iyandikisha mu buryo
bwemewe kandi ako gaciro kakabarwa
nyuma yo gukora ubwicungure
bw’agaciro no kwita ku itakazagaciro
riba ku mpamvu zitari zitezwe;
(e) kugeza kuri 60% by’agaciro nyakuri
kagaragazwa n’ibaruramari k’amazu
y’ubucuruzi yatanzweho ingwate
yakorewe iyandikisha mu buryo
bwemewe kandi ako gaciro kakabarwa
nyuma yo gukora ubwicungure
bw’agaciro no kwita ku itakazagaciro
riba ku mpamvu zitari zitezwe;
(f) kugeza kuri 60% by’agaciro nyakuri
kagaragazwa n’ibaruramari k’ubutaka
n’izindi nyubako byatanzweho ingwate
byakorewe iyandikisha mu buryo
bwemewe kandi ako gaciro kakabarwa
nyuma yo gukora ubwicungure
bw’agaciro no kwita ku itakazagaciro
riba ku mpamvu zitari zitezwe;
(g) kugeza kuri 40% by’agaciro nyakuri
kagaragazwa n’ibaruramari k’imitungo
yatanzweho ingwate yimukanwa kandi
ako gaciro kakabarwa nyuma yo
gukora ubwicungure bw’agaciro no
kwita ku itakazagaciro riba ku mpamvu
zitari zitezwe.

articles.heading: Ivugururwa ry’inguzanyo zatanzwe n’ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza gukora (1) Iyo umunyamuryango cyangwa
articles.text:
umukiriya afite ubushake nyakuri bwo
kwishyura inguzanyo ye, ariko
bikamunanira biturutse ku mpamvu
atabasha kugenzura ubwe, harimo
impanuka, ingorane zitamuturutseho
zishobora kugira ingaruka mbi ku
mushinga we yaherewe inguzanyo,
utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ashobora
kuvugurura ingingo zigize
amasezerano y’inguzanyo yahawe
cyangwa ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza
gukora.
(2) Ingingo zigize amasezerano
y’inguzanyo yatanzwe cyangwa ibyo
umukiriya yiyemeza gukora zishobora
kuvugururwa harimo igihe inguzanyo
izishyurwamo, ingano y’inguzanyo
fatizo n’inyungu zayo, ingwate,
n’izindi ngingo zigize ayo masezerano.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo kuvugurura inguzanyo yatanzwe cyangwa ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza gukora Ibikurikizwa mu kuvugurura inguzanyo
articles.text:
yatanzwe cyangwa ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza
gukora ni ibi bikurikira:
(a) isesengura n’iyemerwa ry’ubusabe
bwo kuvugurura inguzanyo yatanzwe
cyangwa ibyo umukiriya yiyemeza
gukora bikorwa hakurikijwe uburyo
busanzwe bukoreshwa mbere y’uko
hatangwa inguzanyo buba bwaragenwe
muri politiki y’inguzanyo y’utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa;
(b) inguzanyo ivuguruwe ifatwa
nk’inguzanyo nshya, kandi ishingira ku
masezerano mashya;
(c) inguzanyo zivuguruwe zishyirwa mu
cyiciro “zikurikiranwa”, iyo ubwishyu
bushya butangiye gukorwa ku gihe
kandi hakishyurwa ingano
y’amafaranga yumvikanyweho. Iyo
inguzanyo ivuguruwe ariko
hakagaragara ubukererwe mu bwishyu
bwayo, hakurikizwa uburyo busanzwe
bwo gushyira mu byiciro inguzanyo
n’ibibindi biteye nka zo bisezeranwa
abakiriya.
(d) utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ashyiraho uburyo
bugaragara muri politiki ze imbere mu
kigo bwo kubara inyungu n’ibihano
bijyanye n’inguzanyo zivuguruwe;
(e) utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa abika amakuru
yose ajyanye n’impamvu inguzanyo
yavuguruwe, akayabika muri dosiye
y’umukiriya cyangwa
iy’umunyamuryango.

articles.heading: Igihe cy’isubikabwishyu (1) Uwahawe inguzanyo ashobora guhabwa igihe cy’isubikabwishyu mu bihe bidasanzwe aho usanga
articles.text:
umushinga yaherewe inguzanyo
ubangamiwe ku buryo butunguranye
n’ibihe bikomeye by’ubukungu
rusange cyangwa ihungabana
ry’ubukungu, cyangwa ibindi bibazo
birenze ubushobozi bwe.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ashyira muri
politiki zikoreshwa imbere mu kigo
ibisabwa kugira ngo uhabwa
inguzanyo ahabwe igihe
cy’isubikabwishyu.

articles.heading: Uburyo utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa afata ingwate cyangwa ubwishyu bukozwe
articles.text:
n’umwishingizi mu rwego rw’ibaruramari
(1) Ingwate yose ifatiriwe n’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
cyangwa imweguriwe akaba afite
uburenganzira bwo kuyigurisha,
ayivanaho mu gihe kitarenze imyaka
itatu ibarwa uhereye ku itariki ifatira
cyangwa iyegurirwa byatangiriyeho.
(2) Agaciro k’umutungo winjizwa mu
bitabo by’ibaruramari kagomba kuba
ari agaciro nyakuri uwo mutungo
ugezeho ku isoko nyuma yo gukuraho
agaciro uwo mutungo ushobora
gutakaza ku buryo butari bwitezwe.
UMUTWE WA VII: IBIHANO BYO MU
RWEGO RW’UBUTEGETSI

articles.heading: Ibihano bihabwa utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
articles.text:
abitswa utubahiriza ibiteganywa muri aya
mabwiriza cyangwa ibwiriza asabwa
kubahirizwa, ahanishwa kimwe cyangwa
byinshi mu bihano bikurikira bitewe
n’uburemere bw’ikosa yakoze:
(a) kwihanangirizwa mu nyandiko;
(b) kugawa mu nyandiko;
(c) guhagarikirwa by’agateganyo
ubufasha butangwa na Banki Nkuru;
(d) kubuzwa cyangwa guhagarikwa, mu
gihe runaka, gukora ibikorwa bimwe,
cyangwa kugaragarizwa ibindi
atemerewe kongera gukora mu
bikorwa asanzwe akora;
(e) kwamburwa uruhushya.

articles.heading: Kwamburwa uruhushya Banki Nkuru ishobora kwambura utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
articles.text:
uruhushya yahawe kubera nibura imwe mu
mpamvu zikurikira:
(a) kudatangira ibikorwa mu gihe
cy’amezi 12 abarwa uhereye ku munsi
uruhushya rwatangiweho;
(b) guhagarika gukora ibikorwa umuntu
yemerewe gukora Banki Nkuru
ntimenyeshwe iryo hagarika mu
nyandiko;
(c) gukoresha imari shingiro mu
bikorwa bitari ibyatangiwe
uburenganzira na Banki Nkuru;
(d) kutubahiriza ibirebana n’imari
shingiro itagibwa munsi itegetswe
kuba ihari mu gihe cyagenwe;
(e) gukora ibikorwa bitari ibyatangiwe
uburenganzira na Banki Nkuru;
(f) abanyamigabane b’utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
cyangwa we ubwe bahamijwe
n’urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rwo
mu Rwanda cyangwa rwo mu kindi
gihugu icyaha gifitanye isano
n’iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi, cyangwa bashamikiye
kuri sosiyete y’ubucuruzi
yahamijwe icyo cyaha cyangwa ari
ishami ry’iyo sosiyete;
(g) gutanga amakuru y’ibinyoma
cyangwa atari ukuri mu gihe cyo
gusaba uruhushya;
(h) gutera inkunga ibikorwa
binyuranyije n’amategeko
cyangwa kwishora muri ibyo
bikorwa;
(i) kurangwa kenshi no kutubahiriza
ibisabwa mu rwego
rw’igenzuramikorere;
(j) kunanirwa kwishyura imyenda;
(k) kunanirwa gusubukura ibikorwa
nyuma yo guhagarikwa
by’agateganyo;
(l) Banki Nkuru isanga ibikorwa
by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa bibangamiye
imikorere myiza y’urwego
rw’imari n’inyungu rusange.

articles.heading: Ingaruka zo kwamburwa uruhushya (1) Ingaruka ziba ku utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga ufite
articles.text:
uruhushya ruteshejwe agaciro ni izi
zikurikira:
(a) gukurwa ku rutonde
rw’abatanga serivisi z’imari
batakira amafaranga abitswa;
(b) gusabwa gukora iseswa
ritegetswe hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’aya mabwiriza;
(2) Iyo uruhushya ruteshejwe agaciro,
Banki Nkuru ibimenyesha abatanga
serivisi z’imari bagenzurwa ndetse na
rubanda.

articles.heading: Guhagarika by’agateganyo ibikorwa by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa (1) Banki Nkuru ifite ububasha bwo
articles.text:
guhagarika by’agateganyo utanga serivisi
z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa
n’ibikorwa bye mu gihe kitarenze amezi
atandatu, bitewe n’imwe mu mpamvu
zikurikira:
(a) imyitwarire mibi igaruka kenshi nyuma
yo kwihanangirizwa mu nyandiko
cyangwa gucibwa ihazabu;
(b) gutanga sheki itazigamiwe;
(c) kutagira imari igenewe imikorere ya
buri munsi itagibwa munsi cyangwa
imari shingiro isabwa nyuma yo
kwihanangirizwa mu nyandiko;
(d) gukora uburiganya;
(e) kudaha amakuru Banki Nkuru nyuma
yo kwihanangirizwa mu nyandiko.
(2) utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa wahagaritswe by’agateganyo
agomba:
(a) guhagarika by’agateganyo ibikorwa
bye;
(b) gukuraho amatangazo yose yo
kwamamaza cyangwa ibyapa byose
byo ku biro bye.

articles.heading: Ihagarikwa ry’ibikorwa ry’agateganyo ku bushake (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ufite uruhushya
articles.text:
ashobora gusaba Banki Nkuru, mu
nyandiko, guhagarika ibikorwa bye ku
buryo bw’agateganyo, akayishyikiriza
inyandiko zikurikira:
(a) inyandiko isobanura ikigamijwe
mu ihagarikwa ry’ibikorwa
ry’agateganyo n’impamvu zaryo;
(b) inyandiko igaragaza uko
umutungo n’imyenda bizacungwa
mu gihe cy’ihagarikwa
ry’ibikorwa ry’agateganyo;
(c) utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa wahagaritse
ibikorwa by’agateganyo asaba mu
nyandiko gusubukura ibikorwa
bye byahagaritswe nibura mu
byumweru bibiri mbere y’uko
igihe cy’ihagarika ry’ibikorwa
ry’agateganyo rirangira.
(2) Ihagarika ry’agateganyo ry’ibikorwa
by’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ntirishobora
kurenza imyaka itatu.

articles.heading: Ibihano bifatirwa abagize Inama y’Ubuyobozi, abari mu buyobozi cyangwa abakozi Ugize Inama y’Ubuyobozi, uri mu buyobozi
Ibihano by’amafaranga (1) Uretse ibihano byo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi biteganywa mu ngingo ya 75 n’iya 77, Banki Nkuru ishobora
articles.text:
guha ibihano by’amafaranga utanga
serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga
abitswa utubahiriza aya mabwiriza,
amabwiriza yihariye cyangwa
ibyemezo.
(2) Amakosa atuma hatangwa ibihano
by’amafaranga akubiye mu mugereka
wa IV.
(3) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa uciwe amafaranga
y’ihazabu ayishyura Banki Nkuru mu
gihe kitarenze iminsi 30 uhereye ku
itariki amenyesherejweho icyo gihano.
(4) Haseguriwe ibiteganywa n’iyi ngingo,
nta gihano cy’amafaranga gishobora
kurenga 2% by’imari shingiro itagibwa
munsi y’utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa yagenwe muri aya
mabwiriza.
(5) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa utishyuye kuri
konti yagaragajwe na Banki Nkuru
amafaranga y’igihano mu gihe
kivugwa mu gika cya (3) cy’iyi ngingo,
amenyeshwa Ibiro by’Amakuru ku
Myenda kandi agahanishwa igihano
cya 1% by’agaciro k’igihano buri
munsi w’ubukererwe kugeza ubwo
yishyuriye amafaranga yose.
(6) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa ashobora
kujuririra Guverineri wa banki Nkuru
ku bihano by’amafaranga yaciwe,
kandi ibyo akabikora mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi irindwi y’akazi ibarwa uhereye
ku itariki yakiriye ibaruwa
imumenyesha icyo gihano.
(7) Guverineri afata icyemezo ku bujurire
buvugwa mu gika cya (6) mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi 30 uhereye ku munsi
ubujurire bwakiriweho. Icyemezo
Guverineri afashe ku itakambirwa kiba
icyemezo cyo mu rwego rw’ubutegetsi
ntakuka.
UMUTWE WA VIII: INGINGO
ZINYURANYE

articles.heading: Uburyo bw’ikurikiranagihombo (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ntashobora
articles.text:
gutangira igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose
kiganisha ku gihombo cyangwa ku
iseswa ku bushake atabiherewe
uburenganzira bwanditse bwa Banki
Nkuru.
(2) Ubushobozi bw’ikigo bwo kwishyura
abo kibereyemo imyenda bose
bidatinze ni kimwe mu bintu
bigenderwaho na Banki Nkuru mu
gutanga uburenganzira bwo gukora
iseswa ku bushake.
(3) Abanyamigabane ni bo bafite ububasha
bw’iseswa ku bushake kandi ubwo
bubasha babukoreshwa mu nteko
rusange iterana buri mwaka cyangwa
mu nteko rusange idasanzwe.
(4) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa akora iseswa
ritegetswe iyo yambuwe uruhushya
rwe cyangwa iyo agiye mu gihombo.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gutanga serivisi z’imari (1) Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ashobora gutanga
articles.text:
serivisi ze imbonankubone cyangwa
akoresheje uburyo
bw’ikoranabuhanga.
(2) Iyo utanga serivisi z’imari utakira
amafaranga abitswa wahawe
uruhushya ashaka guhindura uburyo
bwo gutanga serivisi kugira ngo atange
serivisi akoresheje uburyo
bw’ikoranabuhanga, agomba kuba
yujuje ibisabwa biteganywa mu
ngingo ya 6.

articles.heading: Ishyirwaho ry’amabwiriza yihariye ajyanye n’ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’aya mabwiriza Mu rwego rwo kunoza ishyirwa mu bikorwa
articles.text:
ry’aya mabwiriza, Banki Nkuru ishobora
gushyiraho amabwiriza yihariye cyangwa
imirongo ngenderwaho byihariye bijyanye na
serivisi runaka bireba.

articles.heading: Kwiyandikisha mu biro by’amakuru ku myenda Utanga serivisi z’imari utakira amafaranga abitswa ahita yiyandikisha mu Biro
articles.text:
by’Amakuru ku myenda, nyuma yo guhabwa
uruhushya, kugira ngo ashobore gusuzuma
ingano y’imyenda abakiriya be bafite, iyo
bibaye ngombwa.

articles.heading: Gukora nta ruhushya rutangwa na Banki Nkuru Uwari we wese utanga serivisi ziteganywa muri aya mabwiriza atabiherewe
articles.text:
uburenganzira na Banki Nkuru, ahanwa
hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga.

articles.heading: Kubahiriza ingano y’imari shingiro yishyuwe itagibwa munsi (1) Abatanga serivisi z’imari batakira
articles.text:
amafaranga abitswa basanzwe bakora
bari mu cyiciro cya II n’icya III bakaba
bari bemerewe gutanga serivisi mu
nzego zihariye bashobora gukomeza
gutanga izo serivisi igihe bujuje
ibisabwa abari mu cyiciro gishya
gikubiyemo izo serivisi.
(2) Abasanzwe batanga serivisi z’imari
batakira amafaranga abitswa badafite
imari shingiro yishyuwe itagibwa
munsi ku itariki aya mabwiriza
atangira gukurikizwa, bagomba kuzuza
iyo mari shingiro ku buryo bukurikira:
(a) 375.000.000 FRW ku batanga
serivisi z’imari batakira
amafaranga abitswa bari mu cyiciro
cya I, na 150.000.000 FRW ku
batanga serivisi z’imari batakira
amafaranga abitswa bari mu cyiciro
cya II, mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri
ibarwa uhereye ku itariki aya
mabwiriza atangira gukurikizwa;
(b) FRW 500.000.000 ku batanga
serivisi z’imari batakira
amafaranga abitswa bari mu cyiciro
cya I, na FRW 200.000.000 ku
batanga serivisi z’imari batakira
amafaranga abitswa bari mu cyiciro
cya II, mu gihe cy’imyaka itatu
ibarwa uhereye ku itariki aya
mabwiriza atangira gukurikizwa.
(3) Ibigo bisanzwe bifite uruhushya rwo
gutanga serivisi z’imari bitakira
amafaranga abitswa bitujuje imari
shingiro itagibwa munsi ku itariki aya
mabwiriza atangarira gukurikizwa,
bishyikiriza Banki Nkuru gahunda
y’uburyo biteganya kongera imari
shingiro mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu
abarwa uhereye ku munsi aya
mabwiriza atangira gukurikizwa.

articles.heading: Agaciro ku mpushya zisanzweho (1) Impushya zatanzwe n’ibikorwa byakozwe hashingiwe ku
articles.text:

A
wa 25/04/2023 agenga abatanga
serivisi z’imari batakira amafaranga
abitswa bikomeza kugira agaciro.
(2) Icyakora, abasanzwe batanga serivisi
z’imari batakira amafaranga abitswa
bafite serivisi zashyizwe mu cyiciro
cyisumbuye hakurikijwe aya
mabwiriza, bagomba gusaba Banki
Nkuru kuvugurura ibyo basabwa
bijyanye n’icyo cyiciro cyisumbuye
mu gihe kitarenze amezi 12 abarwa
uhereye ku itariki y’itangazwa ry’aya
mabwiriza.
